newsitem.title: USA: Christmas boosts December retail sales modestly.
newsitem.headline: Christmas boosts December retail sales modestly.

text.p: Christmas shopping boosted sales at retail stores modestly during December, the Commerce Department said Tuesday, as business picked up at clothing and general merchandise stores.

Total retail sales increased last month by 0.6 percent to a seasonally adjusted $208.2 billion after a revised 0.2 percent decline in November. That was slightly stronger than the 0.5 percent sales gain forecast by Wall Street economists.
